title: Secretary of State Marco Rubio opens G20 plenary session in Atlanta
excerpt: The two-day meeting will address global economic and geopolitical crises including food security and freedom of navigation.
bodyHtml:
United States Secretary of State Marco Rubio opened a G20 plenary session in Atlanta, Georgia, on October 30, 2026. The meeting gathers international leaders to address interconnected economic and geopolitical crises affecting global supply chains, trade, and energy markets.

Secretary Rubio stated that the world is facing severe threats to the foundations of the global economic order. He noted that the G20 must work together to confront these threats, strengthen economic resilience, and safeguard markets.

During the two-day event, participants are scheduled to discuss freedom of navigation and food security. Secretary Rubio requested that interventions be limited to approximately three minutes each to manage the session's agenda. He will wrap up at the end of each topic as the session moves forward.
